hero.title: Invoices, stock and accounts… in one program on your own PC
hero.text: BLR Fatourati is a complete invoicing and business-management program: documents, clients and suppliers, stock, point of sale, payments, expenses and reports. It works fully offline after a single activation, comes with a lifetime license, and your data never leaves your computer.

why.title: Why you need it
why.sub: Running a business on scattered notebooks and spreadsheets costs time and hides the real picture of your profit and debts.
items: Invoices that take time
Automatic numbering, quote to invoice in one click, recurring invoices created for you, then print or share by WhatsApp and email.
Unclear stock
Track quantities, barcodes, movements and valuation, with alerts when an item runs low or out.
Unknown debts and profit
Client and supplier balances, debt ageing, expenses and reports show where you really stand.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
items: Does it work without internet?
Yes. After a single activation the program works fully offline. Only the optional AI assistant needs internet when you use it.
Can I change my computer later?
Yes. The license is bound to one device, so contact support and we will help you move it to your new PC.
How do backups work?
The program makes a daily automatic local backup and keeps the last 14. You can also create an encrypted (AES-256) manual backup and restore it whenever you need.
I forgot my password. What can I do?
Use the one-time recovery key you received to regain access. Keep it somewhere safe.
Can I import data from my old software?
Yes. Clients, suppliers and products can be imported from Excel or CSV files, and the program recognises Arabic, French and English column names.
Can several people use it?
Yes. Create users with roles (administrator, manager, cashier, accountant), and the activity log shows who did what.
Can the developer see my data?
No. Everything is stored in a local SQLite database on your PC and nothing is uploaded to the developer.
Do I need the AI assistant?
No. It is optional and uses your own key. The smart alerts work offline without any AI.
Which printers are supported?
You can print to a standard A4 printer, to an 80 mm thermal receipt printer, or save as PDF, after checking a print preview.
What about updates and new versions?
The license is for life. For news about new versions, contact the developer on WhatsApp or by email.
How can I try it before buying?
Request a trial code and use the full program free for {days}.
